_meta.title: Claude Code subagent recommendations — stack signal → subagent map
_meta.notes: Curated third-party Claude Code subagents (Agent tool specialists) worth surfacing per project. ai-kit recommends, never bundles. Install entries point at the parent plugin/repo — users invoke /plugin install themselves. Subagents differ from plugins in trust surface: they execute via the Agent tool with an explicit tool-list, so each entry documents which tools the subagent gets access to. Mirrors plugins.json schema with additional 'parent_plugin' + 'tools' fields. Built-in subagents (general-purpose, Explore, Plan, statusline-setup) are excluded — always available, not recommendation candidates. ai-kit's own subagents (ai:explore, ai:qa-runner, ai:reviewer) are excluded — installed with ai-kit itself.

recommendations.name: claude-code-guide
recommendations.best_for: Any project where Claude Code / Agent SDK / Anthropic API questions surface during development — features, hooks, slash commands, MCP servers, settings, IDE integrations
recommendations.value: Authoritative answers about the host harness (Claude Code itself) without the main thread chewing through context to re-derive them. Read-only, no code edits.

recommendations.name: caveman:cavecrew-investigator
recommendations.best_for: Brownfield repos with many files where the main thread keeps spending context on 'where is X defined / what calls Y' lookups
recommendations.value: Read-only code locator. Returns file:line tables in caveman-compressed format — tool-result injected back into main context is ~60% smaller than vanilla Explore output. Main context lasts longer across long sessions.

recommendations.name: caveman:cavecrew-builder
recommendations.best_for: Surgical 1-2 file edits — typo fixes, single-function rewrites, mechanical renames, comment removal, format-preserving tweaks
recommendations.value: Bounded scope editor. Hard refuses 3+ file scope. Returns caveman-compressed diff receipt. Use when scope is bounded and obvious; do NOT use for new features, new files, or cross-file refactors.

recommendations.name: caveman:cavecrew-reviewer
recommendations.best_for: PR review / diff review where the main thread wants compressed actionable findings instead of multi-paragraph commentary
recommendations.value: One line per finding, severity-tagged, no praise, no scope creep. Output format `path:line: <emoji> <severity>: <problem>. <fix>.` Skips formatting nits unless they change meaning.
